description: Hardcoded gender blacklists - hanjas that should NEVER appear in opposite gender names

femaleBlacklist.description: Male-only hanjas that should NEVER appear in female names
femaleBlacklist.reason: Strongly masculine characters that would make female names inappropriate

examples.reason: These combinations feel awkward or inappropriate for girls

maleBlacklist.description: Female-only hanjas that should NEVER appear in male names
maleBlacklist.reason: Strongly feminine characters that would make male names inappropriate

examples.reason: These combinations feel awkward or inappropriate for boys

notes: These blacklists override ALL other classification logic
Add characters here ONLY if they are universally recognized as gender-specific
When in doubt, rely on statistical classification instead
These lists should be reviewed annually based on naming trends

usage.female_query: WHERE genderHint IN ('female', 'unisex') OR genderHint IS NULL) AND character NOT IN femaleBlacklist
usage.male_query: WHERE genderHint IN ('male', 'unisex') OR genderHint IS NULL) AND character NOT IN maleBlacklist

history.changes: Initial blacklists based on Korean naming conventions and cultural understanding
